limitations: Drawings establish circuit roles, not exact specimen revision, dimensions or every component marking. Hidden routing and pin-one orientations remain provisional.

motherboard.ram: 32 x 64-Kbit DRAM = 256 KiB. Drawing: U2164; owner photo: M4164B-12.

keyboard.cpu: A5 U880 in schematic; UB880D in owner photo
keyboard.rom: A8 U556/U2716-compatible 2 KiB ROM; transplanted specimen ROM contents unverified
keyboard.matrix: 13 scan selections x 8 inputs; no RAM on controller
keyboard.leds: A6A/A6B DL074 latches: address A14/A13 data, IORQ with A15 low clocks them
keyboard.transistors: Schematic: V4.1–V4.8 SC308C input stages, V3.1/V3.2 SC236D and V4.9 SC308C oscillator stages. Generic TO-92 model; photographed substitutes not electrically identified.
keyboard.unresolved: Detached controller-to-matrix docking orientation and hidden lead bends; no invented joining cable

connectors.role: Video A5, intensity A1, composite sync A3; 0 V B2; vertical sync B1; +12 V A4/B5; return A2/B3; shield B4
connectors.caution: Drawing connector view; not a verified specimen cable wiring instruction

display.controller: SAB8275P in owner photo; D05 8275-compatible device in drawing
display.fetch: Local counters, RAM and multiplexers. Do not conflate with system UA858 floppy DMA.
display.implemented: Seven-bit invisible-attribute data; CA inherits reverse/GPA; status read-clear and parameter-length errors.
display.remaining: Cycle-level row DMA/underrun, 16-byte FIFO overflow timing, light pen, spaced rows and exact raster/IRQ timing are not implemented. Nominal frame/blink timing remains approximate.
